title: Durable intent + idempotent effect wired into governed runtime
scope: runtime.ts composition only: policy revalidation -> approvals.reserve -> journal.reserve -> markExecuting -> markEffectStarted -> tool -> journal.confirmEffect -> approvals.confirm -> outbox.enqueue; replay/in_progress/uncertain/conflict handling; releaseExpired sweep; durability fail-closed; operationKey; reservationTtlMs. Plus tests and harness updates.

failureSemantics.replay: executed with persisted executionRef/resultDigest, zero tool calls, outbox re-enqueued with operationKey
failureSemantics.in_progress: denied operation_in_progress; fresh approval reservation released when applicable
failureSemantics.uncertain: denied operation_uncertain; approval marked UNCERTAIN when reservable
failureSemantics.conflict: denied idempotency_key_reuse; fresh approval reservation released
failureSemantics.preEffectFailure: journal.failEffect + approvals.release -> APPROVED -> denied with tool code
failureSemantics.approvalConfirmFailure: denied approval_confirm_failed with effectConfirmed=true and journal CONFIRMED
failureSemantics.durabilityRequired: HIGH_RISK_WRITE/ADMIN or real_authorized without journal -> denied before tool
failureSemantics.journalSweepFailed: denied journal_sweep_failed at start of runTurn
failureSemantics.markEffectStartedFailure: journal.failEffect + approval release + denied with journal code
